CALL_LD.name: Cross-Asset Lead-Lag & Liquidity Disparity
CALL_LD.mechanism: Delayed transmission of macro orderflow into lower-liquidity altcoins
CALL_LD.rationale: Empirical correlation is negative/flat (-0.018). Retail friction (24 bps) destroys micro-horizon lead-lag.

VOSI_LS.name: Volume-Synchronized Taker Imbalance & Liquidity Shocks
VOSI_LS.observable_information: Hourly Spot taker volume imbalance (buy vol vs sell vol)
VOSI_LS.mechanism: Aggressive orderbook sweeping causing short-term price drift
VOSI_LS.rationale: Empirical correlation with 1h forward returns is effectively zero (-0.005). Arbitraged by HFTs within seconds.

CARM_CC.name: Cross-Asset Relative Momentum & Capital Concentration
CARM_CC.observable_information: 168h (7-day) relative returns across liquid crypto assets
CARM_CC.mechanism: Capital rotation persistence into leading assets during multi-week trend regimes
CARM_CC.rationale: Intermediate 168h momentum provides sufficient horizon to amortize weekly turnover friction, capturing winner persistence.
